visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand holds a sleek grey smartphone in profile against a blurred background. A bright red arrow points to the side buttons. Yellow text "全世界最薄手機?" is prominent at the bottom with white subtitles below. (2) Two smartphones are held side-by-side for comparison: the S25 Edge and the thicker S25 Ultra. The creator, a young male with dark hair and glasses, is partially visible in the background, smiling slightly while demonstrating the width difference. (3) The camera zooms in on the rear of the silver-grey phone, showing two large, circular vertically aligned camera lenses. The lighting is bright and even, reflecting off the metallic surface as the hand rotates the device to show the texture. (4) Multiple smartphones of different colors including light blue, silver, and black are seen hanging from thin wires in a modern event space with blue and white decor. Technical specs in yellow and white text appear on the right side of the screen. (5) The creator, wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and black smart glasses, holds the light blue version of the phone, pointing at the camera modules. He appears in a well-lit indoor venue with product branding and balloons visible in the distance. (6) A black version of the phone is showcased while numerical pricing information (NT.37900, NT.41900) is displayed in yellow boxes on the left. The creator speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with his free hand.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 全世界最薄手機? [Logo]: @Joeman. (2) [Subtitle]: 各位在我手上的是最新發表的 S25 Edge. (3) [Subtitle]: 真的超超級薄 只有 5.8mm. (4) [Subtitle]: 在我旁邊的是 S25 Ultra... 差了要 50% 左右. (5) [Subtitle]: 拿在手上手感非常非常的好 只有 163g. (6) [Subtitle]: 配置跟 S25 Ultra 那個主鏡頭 應該是同一顆 支援到 2 億像素. (7) [Slogan]: 8 Elite for Galaxy 6.7吋 Dynamic AMOLED 2X 200MP廣角主鏡頭 12MP超廣角鏡頭 3900mAh. (8) [Variety]: 鈦輕藍 鈦輕銀 鈦輕黑. (9) [Slogan]: 12+256GB NT.37900 12+512GB NT.41900 (預購優惠37900).

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian male with short dark hair, wearing black glasses and a white long-sleeve sweatshirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A clean, bright product launch exhibition space featuring modern white and blue partitions, decorative silver balloons, and suspended display units for the smartphones.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks enthusiastically with high clarity, introducing a new smartphone. Background music is an upbeat synth-pop track with a strong 4/4 electronic beat. A distinct 'whoosh' transition sound effect punctuates the start. (2) The narration remains fast-paced and energetic as it describes technical dimensions. The background music maintains its consistent rhythmic pulse without interruption. Ambient room noise is virtually undetectable, suggesting a clean recording environment. (3) A subtle 'pop' sound effect occurs as technical specifications appear on screen. The narrator's pitch variability increases to emphasize key numbers like '5.8mm' and '163g'. The synthesizer melody in the BGM remains bright and airy. (4) The narrator transitions to discussing camera specs and pricing. The voice tone becomes slightly more professional but remains high-arousal. The percussion in the music provides a steady drive throughout the detailed list of hardware features. (5) Final remarks regarding battery life and heat dissipation are delivered with a friendly, conversational tone. The background music begins a gentle fade out during the last few seconds, ending cleanly alongside the speaker's closing statement.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Comparison -> Key Specifications -> Color Showcase -> Pricing -> Summary/Call-to-action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a quick, high-energy first look at the Samsung Galaxy S25 Edge, emphasizing its extremely thin profile, weight, and premium camera features for tech enthusiasts.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of the product, detailed specifications provided by the creator, and attendance at a launch event with branding.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses fast-paced editing and social-media-friendly captions to maintain high viewer engagement while delivering technical data.
